standard: course-sentence-translation 技能 R1–R4；键取自对齐原串

entries.en: What are you doing this weekend?
Well, it’s just that we’ve got that History test coming up.
entries.zh: 嗯，就是我们马上要考历史了。

entries.en: Do you want to study together?
It’s the cup final and I can’t miss that.
OK, so what about Friday night?
Dad’s taking me to the sports centre to watch the basketball game, but it doesn’t finish until 10 pm.
entries.zh: 爸爸要带我去体育中心看篮球赛，比赛要到晚上 10 点才结束。
好，那星期六下午怎么样。
星期六下午，星期六下午。

entries.en: It’s my brother’s birthday, so we’re going to the restaurant to celebrate.
entries.zh: 那是我弟弟的生日，所以我们要去餐厅庆祝。

entries.en: You know, that new American diner on the high street.
entries.zh: 你知道的，就是高街上那家新开的美式餐厅。

entries.en: Oh, yeah, I’ve heard it’s very good.
entries.zh: 哦，对，我听说过那家店很好。

entries.en: What time do you think you’ll finish there?
entries.zh: 你觉得你们大概什么时候能结束？

entries.en: Probably about 5 pm, but then I’m meeting Nathan.
entries.zh: 大概下午 5 点，不过之后我要和内森碰面。

entries.en: We’re going to see the new Spider-Man film at the cinema.
entries.zh: 我们要去电影院看新的《蜘蛛侠》电影。

entries.en: Hey, would you like to come?
Hmmm, Spider-Man – not really my thing.
entries.zh: 嗯，《蜘蛛侠》——不太合我的口味。

entries.en: I guess that just leaves Sunday.
entries.zh: 我想那只剩下星期天了。

entries.en: Well, my grandparents are coming over and we’re taking them to that outdoor museum.
entries.zh: 嗯，我的祖父母要来，我们要带他们去那个露天博物馆。

entries.en: Oh, the one with all the cool old buildings?
entries.zh: 哦，就是那个有很多很酷老建筑的地方吗？

entries.en: My grandad loves that sort of stuff.
entries.zh: 我爷爷就喜欢那种东西。

entries.en: I’d invite you, but I’m really sorry, we haven’t got any room in the car.
entries.zh: 我本想邀请你，但真的很抱歉，车里没有空位了。

entries.en: I don’t want to see old buildings, Connor.
I want to study for the test.
Sunday evening maybe, but only after 8 pm.
entries.zh: 也许星期天晚上，但只能在晚上 8 点以后。

entries.en: I’ve got a piano lesson from 7 to 8 and we won’t be back from the museum much before 6 pm.
entries.zh: 我从 7 点到 8 点有钢琴课，我们从博物馆回来最早也要快 6 点了。

entries.en: I’ve got loads of free time next weekend.
entries.zh: 我下个周末有很多空闲时间。
